title: In vivo delineation of subdivisions of the human amygdaloid complex in a high-resolution group template

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The nuclei of the human amygdala remain difficult to distinguish in individual subject structural magnetic resonance images.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《In vivo delineation of subdivisions of the human amygdaloid complex in a high-resolution group template》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】To address this, high spatial resolution, three-dimensional templates, using joint high accuracy diffeomorphic registration of T1- and T2-weighted structural images from 168 typical adults between 22 and 35 years old released by the Human Connectome Project were constructed.

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】No substantial sex or age differences were found in amygdala volumes normalized to total intracranial volume, or subdivision volumes normalized to amygdala volume.

evidence.text: To address this, high spatial resolution, three-dimensional templates, using joint high accuracy diffeomorphic registration of T1- and T2-weighted structural images from 168 typical adults between 22 and 35 years old released by the Human Connectome Project were constructed.
No substantial sex or age differences were found in amygdala volumes normalized to total intracranial volume, or subdivision volumes normalized to amygdala volume.
